startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: AliExpress product (/item/) or seller (/store/) page URLs to screenshot.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Product (per-country proxy + fingerprint, MTOP token gate, fast rotate on block)
Seller (real IP, no fingerprint, solve captcha via 2captcha)
mode.description: Which browser strategy to use. Product mode validates the session with the signed MTOP token before rendering, so blocked sessions rotate in seconds; seller mode solves captchas in place via 2captcha.

shipToCountry.title: Ship-to Country
shipToCountry.description: Product mode only. Force one ship-to country (ISO-3166 alpha-2, e.g. ES, DE, VN) for every URL. Leave empty to auto-detect it per URL from the locale subdomain (es./de./vi.) or the gatewayAdapt stamp. The detected country drives the storefront host, the proxy exit country, the browser timezone, the region cookie and the signed product API call together — mixing them is what triggers captchas.

residentialProxy.title: Residential Proxy Everywhere
residentialProxy.description: Product mode only. Force the RESIDENTIAL proxy group for every country. Non-US ship-to already uses residential automatically (the datacenter pool holds US IPs only); US uses the cheaper, faster datacenter pool unless this is on.

format.title: Screenshot Format
format.description: Output image format. JPEG is captured at quality 85.

fullPage.title: Full Page Screenshot
fullPage.description: Capture the entire scrollable page (lazy-loads images first) instead of just the viewport.

maxCaptureScreens.title: Max Capture Depth
maxCaptureScreens.description: Full-page mode only. How deep to scroll and capture, counted in viewport-heights — 3 screens at the default 1080px viewport is 3240px of page. Seller (/store/) pages lazy-load products endlessly, so without a cap the scroll never reaches the bottom and the run hits its timeout. Set 0 for no cap — only safe on product (/item/) pages, which are finite.

headless.title: Headless Browser
headless.description: Local debugging only. Set false to watch the browser drive the page. Always leave true on the platform.

twoCaptchaApiKey.title: 2captcha API Key
twoCaptchaApiKey.description: Seller mode only. Falls back to TWOCAPTCHA_API_KEY env var.
